title: Sufficiency of Proposed ChiLow Round Counts
summary: The known attacks cover the current round settings, while it remains unresolved whether the proposed round increase prevents them.

formal_statement.body: $R_{32}=10$ and $R_{40}=9$ should suffice to prevent the presented MitM attacks.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis focused on meet-in-the-middle attacks against full ChiLow.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish whether the proposed round counts prevent the presented meet-in-the-middle attacks.

progress.summary: The source frames the proposed round increase as sufficient because the attacks are relatively close to the security claim. This remains a heuristic claim without a proof or exhaustive cryptanalysis establishing sufficiency.
citation_labels: Eran Lambooij et al., Meet-in-the-Middle Attacks on Full ChiLow
